question: Does the default (A19 profile v20) score higher when a bot seat plays the deep A19 search (8 rollouts, shortlist 10, max melee 16) on the decisions where it fits a think budget of 2,800 rollout turns (about 4 s on the 2-vCPU test host), through the production a19-deep-fit-v1 driver?
origin: Owner, 2026-11-21: "4s is fine" (per AI move). Confirmation I: deep search on every decision +6.57 (95% +3.76..+9.44), ~4x the search work. Confirmation K (deep when it fits 1,400 turns, ~2 s): G1 FAILED, +1.22 (97.5% -1.64..+4.03); it stays failed.

candidate.driver: production a19-deep-fit-v1 (prod18 common src/simulation/v0_8_a19_deep_fit.ts, V08_A19_DEEP_FIT: rolloutTurnBudget 2800, predictedDeepToStockRatio 4.07, thinkMs 4000; SearchDriver.chooseDecisionWithinBudget): the unchanged stock search first; the deep search started only when stock turns x 5.07 <= 2,800, limited to 2,800 - stock turns (and, live only, 4,000 ms from the decision start); its choice played only when it completed within that budget, otherwise the stock choice
candidate.seam: entrant seat only: HOC_RESEARCH_ENTRANT_PROD_DEEP_FIT=1 in prod18 research ranked_adapter.ts (createBotSeatSearchDriver with deepFit); the other seat keeps the stock driver; deterministic work mode
candidate.parity: prod18 "{}" control == the production control (prod16-ctl) 6/6; production driver at 2,800 == an independent implementation of the rule (research drivers, deep search run to completion, budget 2800, predict 4.07) 6/6 on dfpar-dev-6; the same comparison at 1,400 was 60/60; unit tests 8/8

control: HOC_RESEARCH_ENTRANT_SEARCH="{}" on prod18: the matched two-driver stock control.
why: Development, 600 v20 mirror tasks vs the matched control (lab trees, budgets chosen after seeing them, hence this sealed bank): deep when stock + deep <= 640 turns +0.08; <= 1,400 +5.25 (sealed in K: +1.22); <= 2,800 +7.42 (+2.9..+11.8), deep played on 84% of decisions; deep always +6.33.

populations.mirror: both seats draft as the v20 default (primary)
populations.owner: the opponent drafts strikers from the bundle and at levels 2-3 and casters at levels 1 and 4 (guard)

bank.families: all 186 families 0000-0185 of the pool (seeds10), audited at allocation against 855 ledgers (every earlier namespace including keep-attack-20261121-v1, every league and bank file of this study, the Premium collection seeds) before any bank file was written: 0 intersections

primaryEndpoint: Mean over all 1,674 mirror tasks of candidate-arm minus control-arm score for the entrant. 95% interval from 10,000 bootstrap resamples over pool families, seed 20261132, percentile 2.5 / 97.5.

gates.G1: Lower bound of the primary interval above zero.
gates.G2: No map of the mirror with an estimate below -2 points.
gates.G3: Owner guard: the difference over all owner tasks is at least -2 points.
gates.G4: Candidate-arm games with a quality error not more than control-arm games with one (both populations).
gates.G5: A rerun of the 30 mirror tasks of bank/cfM-g5.json (candidate arm) on the second host reproduces the digests.

cost: Recorded, not gated: CPU per game per arm and host; deep-fit statistics per game (decisions, attempted, played, overran).
adoptionRule: If G1, G2 and G3 pass, the driver is confirmed and is adopted into the default (bot seats only; Premium advice keeps the stock search) at the owner-approved think budget of about 4 s, after the production gates. A failed gate stays failed; G4 and G5 are recorded either way. Live think time and the share of deep decisions are measured on the test host after the owner approves the deploy.
notClaimed: Strength against people; strength under wall-clock deadlines or host load; any other budget.

execution.specs: v19-both.json (mirror), v19.json (owner); same spec both arms
execution.hosts: x3d (hft) prod18: owner control, owner candidate, then G5 (8 processes, nice 19, own autogroup); Mac prod18: mirror control, mirror candidate (12 processes) after confirmation L finishes there
execution.analysis: confirm_m_analyze.py (dry-run on confirmation I rows before registration)
